summary: First-finish smoke test on backend + frontend for Frota Escolar OS Management. All critical API endpoints work (auth, vehicles, users approval, OSs, status update, filters, stats, role protection). Admin login, admin dashboard with edit dialog, driver login, driver dashboard, new OS form all render with expected data-testids.
passed: POST /api/auth/login ADMIN001/admin123 returns JWT (token field) + user
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin user
POST /api/vehicles creates vehicle (ABC1234 Mercedes OF-1721)
GET /api/vehicles returns list
POST /api/auth/register creates pending driver (approved=false)
Pending driver login blocked with 'Cadastro aguardando aprovação do supervisor'
GET /api/users?approved=false lists pending user
PATCH /api/users/{id} {approved:true} approves driver
Approved driver login + /auth/me works
POST /api/service-orders auto-generates os_number OS-2026-0001, status=Pendente, status_history seeded
GET /api/service-orders scoped to own OS for driver
GET /api/service-orders returns all OSs for supervisor
PATCH /api/service-orders/{id} updates status (Em Análise) + supervisor_notes and appends status_history
Status filter ?status=Em%20Análise returns matching OS
GET /api/stats returns total/by_status/pending_users
Role protection: driver PATCH service-order -> 403, POST vehicle -> 403, GET users -> 403
Login UI loads, admin login redirects to /admin
Admin dashboard shows filter-search, OS table with OS-2026-0001, edit dialog opens with edit-status-select + edit-notes-input
Driver dashboard shows create-os-button and OS list with supervisor note
New OS form renders vehicle-select, description-input, submit-os-btn
action_items: Minor: Radix DialogContent is missing aria-describedby/Description (accessibility warning only, not blocking).

notes.login_response_field: Backend returns 'token' (not 'access_token'); frontend handles it correctly.
